plugins.prepareCmd: npm version ${nextRelease.version} --workspaces --include-workspace-root --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version && npm run build && cp README.md CHANGELOG.md packages/vscode/ && cd packages/vscode && npx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies
plugins.publishCmd: if [ -n "$VSCE_PAT" ]; then cd packages/vscode && npx @vscode/vsce publish -p $VSCE_PAT --packagePath ./*.vsix; fi
